reviewContext.userProblem: ccusage-gauge shows only a single cost-budget pie and has no visibility into Claude Code and Codex subscription rate limits (5-hour and weekly windows). The user wants current utilization, percent remaining, and time to reset for both providers on the web dashboard and as pie charts, and wants to choose which pies (budget, Claude 5h, Claude weekly, Codex 5h, Codex weekly) are shown, several at once, on both the dashboard and the macOS menu bar.
requiredOutcomes: AppCore rate-limit module returns claude and codex entries with fiveHour/weekly windows (usedPercent, remainingPercent = clamp(100 - used, 0, 100), resetsAt), status ok/stale/unauthorized/unavailable, and a fixed-text errorCode/message; unit tests cover the exact Claude and Codex sample payloads, Codex window classification by limit_window_seconds including weekly-only primary with null secondary, JSONL fallback, expired-token handling, and per-provider isolation.

GET /api/rate-limits served identically by DashboardRouter and MachineDashboardRouter before snapshot loading and machine parsing; 405 for non-GET, 503 when no service; body contains only derived numbers, status, planType, and timestamps.

Dashboard rate-limit panel with remaining percent and time-to-reset for Claude Code and Codex 5h/weekly, plus a multi-pie panel with five aria-pressed toggles persisted as DashboardUIState.pieCharts (default [budget]).

Menu-bar Settings > Pie charts multi-select persisted as AppState.menuBarPieCharts (default [budget]); multi-pie template glyph and dropdown rate-limit rows; default glyph byte-identical to today; no rate-limit fetch while only budget is selected.
One shared RateLimitUsageService.production() per process wired in Sources/AppCLI/Runtime.swift and MenuBarApp.swift; tracked dashboard assets regenerated.
README section documenting feature, data sources, privacy, statuses, pie selection, and an API example.
Gate: mise run build, mise run test, mise run lint, mise run frontend:check, mise run frontend:test all exit 0.
nonGoals: Remote-machine rate limits (scope is always local).
Token refresh, any write to the Keychain, ~/.claude, or ~/.codex, new configuration keys, CLI client subcommands.
Claude per-model sub-limits (seven_day_opus, seven_day_sonnet) and rendering of Codex otherWindows in the UI.
Changes to cost, budget, aggregation, or cache behavior beyond making the budget pie one selectable chart.
Changing the menu-bar status title text or the budget pie drawing.
Commits, pushes, branches, worktrees, or stashes by workers.
constraints: Never log, print, persist, commit, or expose OAuth access/refresh tokens or account IDs; tests use sentinels test-claude-access-token, test-codex-access-token, test-codex-account-id.

Credentials read-only, fresh per attempt, held only inside one fetch via RedactedSecret; Claude Keychain read only through /usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s 'Claude Code-credentials' -w with a 10s timeout, never SecItemCopyMatching.
In-memory cache with a 60-second minimum interval per provider (failures throttled too), single-flight fetches, per-provider failure isolation.
Backward-compatible decoding: state.json and dashboard state without the new fields decode to [budget]; decode [String] and normalize, never [PieChartID].
Swift 6 language mode, every Swift file under 1000 lines (MenuBarApp.swift is 945, HTTPService.swift 693, MachineDashboardRouter.swift 753), swiftlint clean, no emojis, English only.
frontend/src/App.tsx grows by roughly 40 lines at most; the rate-limit resource is read only through shieldResource(rateLimitsResource) and never feeds errorMessage, hasFailedRequest, or isFetching.
Single shared working tree on main; each worker edits only its plan's writePaths and its own Progress Log; no mise run build / frontend:build / bun run build before rl-09.
No AI tool attribution or co-authorship in commit messages.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Separate dashboard (DashboardUIState.pieCharts via /api/dashboard-state SQLite) and menu-bar (AppState.menuBarPieCharts in state.json) selections, avoiding a new HTTP mutation path into state.json (QA decision 1).
Keychain read via /usr/bin/security because the item's ACL already trusts that tool; a Security-framework read would prompt for each unsigned build (QA decision 2).
Codex windows classified by limit_window_seconds (18000 fiveHour, 604800 weekly, else other), never by primary/secondary position; first window of each kind wins the slot.

Stale fallback: newest of last-good observation and (Codex only) newest session JSONL token_count rate_limits event; expired windows dropped; Claude tokenExpired/unauthorized always reports unauthorized even with a last-good result (rl-01 Status Algorithm is authoritative, QA decision 6).
Redirects refused by the transport so a bearer token is never forwarded; ephemeral URLSession with no cache or cookies.
Rate-limit pies fill their used share like the budget pie; default single-budget glyph is returned unchanged from MenuBarPieIcon.image (QA decision 7).

Menu bar fetches only while a rate-limit pie is selected; refreshRateLimitsIfNeeded() runs on every refresh() regardless of snapshot early returns and is followed by updateStatusIcon() (PR-M2, QA decision 5).
intentionalTradeoffs: Opening the dashboard always triggers rate-limit fetches because the panel is always shown; bounded by the 60s server throttle.
Wave-mates share one working tree, so swift build may break transiently while a sibling is mid-edit; overview protocol rule 4 applies and rl-09 re-runs the full gate.
refreshRateLimitsIfNeeded() at the top of refresh() may read currentState from before this tick's reload, lagging at most one tick.
Interactive glyph-update check and the live curl smoke may be recorded as skipped without a GUI session or an owned service lifecycle; non-disclosure is proven by RateLimitUsageIntegrationTests.
The design-doc status table reads ambiguously for Claude 401 with a last-good result; rl-01's Status Algorithm is authoritative.
Upstream endpoint drift and Keychain prompt variance are accepted risks; failures degrade to unavailable.
supportedEdgeCases: Any Claude window null or missing utilization; unknown response keys ignored; resets_at with 6 fractional digits and +00:00 offset.
Codex weekly-only primary with null secondary; swapped primary/secondary lengths; generic lengths into otherWindows; missing rate_limit; reset_at absent but reset_after_seconds present.
Claude expiresAt in the past: tokenExpired with zero transport calls; 401/403 unauthorized; 429 rate_limited; 3xx and other statuses http_error.
Missing, unreadable, or API-key-only credential files map to credentials_missing or credentials_unreadable.
JSONL fallback skips null rate_limits lines, malformed lines, and unreadable files; re-sorted by modification time; maxFiles bound.
Concurrent current() calls share one in-flight fetch; failures cached for the throttle interval.
Legacy state files without pie fields decode to [budget]; unknown and duplicate pie IDs dropped; the last selected pie cannot be deselected.
/api/rate-limits with machine query parameters returns the same body; snapshot failure does not affect the route; a failed /api/rate-limits request does not affect the rest of the dashboard.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Rate limits for remote machines or extra per-machine Codex session directories (QA decision 4).
Refreshing expired tokens on behalf of the CLIs.
Syncing the dashboard and menu-bar pie selections.
Showing Codex otherWindows or Claude per-model weekly limits in the UI.
